title: AgenticRL: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Self-Refinement for Complex UAV Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2606.03963v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning enables autonomous robots to learn complex navigation tasks, but still relies heavily on time consuming manual reward design and fine tuning. Existing automated reward generation and refinement methods reduce this effort, yet often lack task-level behavioral diagnosis for directing subsequent reward revisions. We introduce AgenticRL, a multimodal closed loop framework in which role-specialized agents generate executable rewards, diagnose failures of the resulting policies, formulate targeted refinement instructions, and regenerate improved rewards. Before training, a task grounding stage automatically selects a compatible action profile, together with its observation and reward interfaces. Each generated reward is used to train a policy using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), which is subsequently evaluated under randomized conditions. translated_title: AgenticRL：面向复杂无人机导航的具有自我精炼能力的智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 深度强化学习使自主机器人能够学习复杂的导航任务，但仍然严重依赖耗时的手动奖励设计和微调。现有的自动化奖励生成与精炼方法减少了这一工作量，但往往缺乏用于指导后续奖励修订的任务级行为诊断。我们提出了AgenticRL，这是一个多模态闭环框架，其中角色专门化的智能体生成可执行的奖励、诊断所得策略的失败之处、制定有针对性的精炼指令，并重新生成改进后的奖励。在训练之前，任务接地阶段会自动选择兼容的动作配置，以及相应的观测和奖励接口。每个生成的奖励都用于通过近端策略优化（PPO）训练一个策略，随后在随机化条件下对其进行评估。任务级行为、几何和安全度量被……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: AgenticRL提出了一种多模态闭环智能体强化学习框架，通过角色专门化的智能体自动生成奖励、诊断策略失败并迭代精炼奖励，同时利用任务接地阶段自动配置动作与观测奖励接口，从而摆脱手动奖励设计，实现复杂无人机导航任务的自主训练。
en_tdlr: AgenticRL introduces a multimodal closed-loop agentic reinforcement learning framework in which role-specialized agents automatically generate, diagnose, and iteratively refine rewards, combined with a task grounding stage that auto-selects action profiles and interfaces, eliminating manual reward design for complex UAV navigation.
